name: Reaper Soul Shock diminishes on players, refreshes on out-of-combat creatures, like Sap (#197)
contract: Soul Shock 803989 (Reaper, class 30, level 8) carries Sap's data: Mechanic 30 MECHANIC_SAPPED on a SPELL_AURA_MOD_STUN effect, DurationIndex 31 = 8000 ms, RecoveryTime and CategoryRecoveryTime 0, Stances FORM_STEALTH (Underwalk 800797), SPELL_ATTR1_ONLY_PEACEFUL_TARGETS (target cannot be in combat), SPELL_ATTR1_ALLOW_WHILE_STEALTHED, SPELL_ATTR3_SUPPRESS_TARGET_PROCS (no initial aggro), SPELL_ATTR5_LIMIT_N and a TAKE_DAMAGE aura interrupt, the same restrictions as Sap 2070/6770/11297/51724. Its tooltip names no cooldown and no diminishing returns, and the client's CrowdControl.lua files 803989 under CROWD_CONTROL_TYPE_INCAPACITATE, like Sap 2070. In 3.3.5 that category diminishes only on players and player-controlled units, so on a player successive applications within 15 sec last 8, 4 and 2 sec and the fourth is immune, while an ordinary creature gets the full 8 sec on every recast for as long as it stays out of combat; damage breaks the effect and a creature in combat refuses the cast (SPELL_FAILED_TARGET_AFFECTING_COMBAT 110). Issue #197 asked for 8/4/2 on a creature; neither the tooltip nor the spell data supports creature diminishing or a cooldown, so this records the Sap-equivalent contract.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and player setup settle
The Reaper enters Underwalk
Soul Shock saps the rival player
The first application on a player lasts the full 8 sec
The sapped player is stunned
Soul Shock does not engage the player
Soul Shock does not break Underwalk
The second application on a player is diminished to 4 sec
The third application on a player is diminished to 2 sec
The diminished sap has expired
The fourth cast on the player is accepted
The fourth cast completes
The player is immune to a fourth application within 15 sec
Let the global cooldown end
Soul Shock saps the creature
The first application on the creature lasts 8 sec
Soul Shock does not engage the creature
The second application on the creature refreshes the full 8 sec, not 4
The third application on the creature refreshes the full 8 sec, not 2
The fourth application on the creature still lasts 8 sec, no immunity
The creature is still stunned
The chained creature is still out of combat
The Reaper is still in Underwalk
Damage breaks Soul Shock
The attacked creature is in combat
Let the global cooldown end
A creature in combat refuses Soul Shock (TARGET_AFFECTING_COMBAT)
The creature in combat stays unsapped
